210001.description:
Ash had devoted himself to his adoptive father to repay the debt of gratitude he owed for being taken in as an orphan. But the truth he learned on his deathbed was quite different. All his hard work, the trust he had built, and even his innate, most powerful ability—the “Seven Wings”—had been stolen from him...! ...Well then, let’s begin the reversal of his life.

(Source: SORAJIMA, translated)

210006.description:
I came to overcome 55 cycles of reincarnation The protagonist, Hanbit, is kidnapped by a goddess and undergoes 55 cycles of reincarnation in this alternate world in search of a clue that might save the world of “Erport.” However, undergoing 55 cycles of reincarnation means enduring the agony of death 55 times. Tired of suffering, Hanbit confesses to the goddess that he can’t go on, and returns to his original world.

But the game he started just to pass the time turns out to be the very world where he endured 55 cycles of reincarnation, and the deeper he delves into it, the more he realizes that the goddess’s dark conspiracy awaits him...

Will Hanbit be able to uncover the goddess’s sinister motives?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 귀환자의 히든 공략 스트리밍

210007.description:
Aki, who works at Tsukiyono Drink, a mid-sized beverage company in Gunma, is transferred to the Intellectual Property Department. Her boss, Kitawaki, seconded from the parent company, is an intellectual property elite with a patent attorney qualification, but he's also an eccentric who enjoys ordering famous sweets from all over Japan and eating them alone. Just as she eagerly begins her new job, her best friend, who runs a clothing brand, is about to be sued by a corrupt company, and a parody product that alters the company's logo is discovered. Aki is thrown into chaos by her unfamiliar work.

Each time, she is supported by Kitawaki's knowledge and experience, and manages to overcome these challenges. Just when she thinks that, Tsukiyono Drink's new tea product, which the company has staked its future on, is in danger of being canceled due to infringement of another company's rights. What can Aki do to protect the technology that everyone worked so hard to develop—the culmination of sweat and tears!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: それってパクリじゃないですか？ 〜新米知的財産部員のお仕事〜
title.romaji: Sore tte Pakuri ja Nai desu ka?: Shinmai Chiteki Zaisan Buin no Oshigoto

210008.description:
Aki Fujisaki, an employee at the mid-sized beverage manufacturer Tsukiyono Drinks, is transferred to the Intellectual Property Department, which is responsible for securing trademark rights for the company's patents. Completely new to intellectual property, Aki is put through the wringer by her boss, patent attorney Kitawaki, as she struggles to overcome trademark hijacking cases and lawsuits over parody products. Then, an unexpected major incident occurs!?

A thrilling workplace story of a rookie intellectual property employee's struggles!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: それってパクリじゃないですか？ 新米知的財産部員のお仕事
title.romaji: Sore tte Pakuri ja Nai desu ka? Shinmai Chiteki Zaisan Buin no Oshigoto

210009.description:
In Country H, following revisions to the Juvenile Law, minors convicted of serious crimes were sent to “rehabilitation facilities” (juvenile reformatories). However, in reality, these were merely nominal punishments where violence reigned supreme.

High school student Gen Amemori, subjected to daily bullying, finally faces an injustice when his beloved dog is mauled to death by the dog of Kanemoto, the ringleader of the bullies. Enraged, Gen inflicts serious injuries on Kanemoto and is sent to the reformatory. There, he is mistreated as one of the lowest-ranking inmates, but eventually meets Shinya Koujou, the facility’s strongest fighter, who drills “the art of survival” into him. With his daily life stolen and his dignity trampled, Gen vows to carve out his own path through reality with his fists. Will he be swallowed by the spiral of violence, or will he fight back and break free?

The counterattack from the bottom begins now!

(Source: Piccoma, translated)

十番様の縁結び　神在花嫁綺譚

210012.description:
Born into one of Japan's most prominent celebrity families, Aoi had come to a summer resort with three of her favorite female friends. Yui, a model; Riko, a novelist; Himari, a sprinter… these beautiful girls shone like jewels in every way, from their looks and status to their talents. As night fell over the resort and complete darkness enveloped them, the four girls decided to take turns revealing "secrets they hadn't told anyone else"!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 誰にも言えない

210013.description:
Mika Ono works for a minor magazine department at a major publishing company, until one day she's thrust into the AMA editorial department. It's full of rising stars and gorgeous men, but they're even more twisted than she ever imagined. Meanwhile, Mika's looking forward to living on her own - that is, until her new address comes with an unfamiliar man attached...! Now, the two will have to cohabit in secret!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Our Two Bedroom Story: Tsumugu Kido
title.native: 上司と秘密の2LDK Love happening ～城戸紡編～
title.romaji: Joushi to Himitsu no 2LDK Love Happening: Kido Tsumugu-hen

210014.description:
Born into one of Japan's most affluent families, Aoi has come to stay at a cottage with her favorite friends: popular model Yui, up-and-coming novelist Riko, and Olympic hopeful sprinter Himari. The four beautiful girls, each radiating a jewel-like brilliance, are about to reveal their "most cherished secrets" that they haven't told anyone else... You won't be able to take your eyes off the shocking "secrets" that these four girls reveal!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 誰にも言えない

210015.description:
Aya Zaizen, 31, works at a famous Japanese trading company. There, she serves as assistant to executive Keiichiro Kijo. Though Aya's earned the trust of harsh and hard-headed Keiichiro, she's never been in love before and considers quitting to pursue that experience instead. Keiichiro doesn't agree, and after interrogating Aya, suggests he'll be her lover instead. The spicy, long-awaited tale of a domineering director and his virginal assistant, now in manga format!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

210017.description:
Ukawa, a first-year oil painting student at an art university, is blessed with promising talent, yet feels a disconnect between his own attitude towards romance and that of those around him, leading him to spend his days alone. He is drawn to the beauty of Kou, an upperclassman he meets at university, but keeps his distance due to Kou's apparent womanizing. However, after a chance encounter, Ukawa learns that Kou harbors a secret desire to be embraced by a man, and makes a proposition to him...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: プンクトゥム

210018.description:
After breaking off her engagement with her fiancé, Karliana makes a fresh start and becomes a librarian at the royal library. One day, a seemingly frivolous, handsome young man named Dietosius appears before her. Impressed by Karliana's intelligence and thirst for knowledge, Dietosius asks, "Would you like to become my personal librarian?"

(Source: Compass, translated)

title.romaji: Konyaku Haki Sarete Jiyuu wo Teniireta Onna Hakushaku desu ga, Chishiki wo Ikashite Shisho ni Nattara Ou Otouto Denka ni Mitomerare, Senzoku ni Narimashita

210019.description:
The protagonist, a young girl, has been ostracized because of her eyes that can see monstrous figures. Her deceased grandfather had told her that this power would one day be useful, but nothing good ever came of it, and she lost her life and was reincarnated in another world. Born as Satsuki, the eldest daughter of a noble family, she is branded as incompetent because she has no magical powers, and is treated like a servant. Moreover, just like in her previous life, she can see monstrous figures that are invisible to those around her. Her fate begins to change when she meets Ichii, a soldier who notices Satsuki's ability to see these monstrous figures.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

210021.description:
Mizuho, ​​a 32-year-old woman, divorces her husband after 10 years of marriage due to his infidelity and returns to her parents' home. On her way, she stops by the sea and discovers a man drowning. Mizuho, ​​with her strong-willed, committee-leader personality, cannot ignore the situation and attempts to save him, disregarding her own safety, but ends up drowning herself. When Mizuho wakes up, she finds herself in a guesthouse run by the man she tried to save...

This is the beginning of a mature romance for Mizuho, ​​a serious woman who is also uncomfortable around men.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

Five handsome men from an otome game are reincarnated into the life of Tokiko, who loves otome games!

210023.description:
"Will you kiss me? I'll die if things stay like this..."

Kai, a high school girl, encounters a couple who have broken up over a trivial matter at her part-time job. Just as she was thinking that she wanted to be careful and cherish her own love life, she unexpectedly reunites with Azuma, who had been dumped, at a committee meeting!? While feeling uneasy around Azuma, she is flustered by his help, and then she encounters him again when he is being dumped by another girl...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

210024.description:
Suou is the perfect student council president, handsome, academically gifted, and athletically talented—everyone admires him. However, he has a hidden side: his approach to the secretary, Nagi, is heavy and annoying! Despite Nagi's cold and dismissive responses, the president relentlessly pursues her.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 恋する会長はめんどくさい

210025.description:
One day, a mysterious creature calling itself "Usapyon" appears in the room of Soma, a college student leading an empty life. This being, which looks human but isn't, calls Soma "older brother" and forces him to play video games with it... Before he knows it, his room is filled with pink things!?

Involving those around them, something that had been stagnant begins to move. A strange and cute cohabitation comedy!

(Source: Shu-Cream, translated)

title.native: うさぴょん

210026.description:
Rino Kasuga, a high school girl who loves cooking, moves to Tokyo from a rural mountain village. Her next-door neighbor in the apartment building, Kaoru Todo, looks just like a yakuza...! One day, she helps Todo, who has collapsed in front of her house from hunger, and ends up cooking for him on a regular basis...?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: ナイショのお隣さん

210027.description:
Kaoru Kirishima hates guys who are just putting on a show and looking cool. Hoshino, the most popular prince at school, is no exception and she hates him too! But when she sees Hoshino crying, what is the true nature of the feelings that well up inside her for the first time...? When you're in love, you can't pretend to be cool!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

210028.description:
Tired of her job at an advertising agency, Hanaoka Kaori takes a new job in the public relations department of the peaceful, nature-rich village of Soranagi. This village is filled with the sky, the land, and a slightly eccentric village mayor... Is her second career a complete failure?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.romaji: Soranagi Mura ni wa Nannimo Nai!: Soranagi Mura Kouhou-ka

A story about two women spending a languid, hot summer afternoon together.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

210034.description:
Despite being a small nation, the Kingdom of Ulmira continues to win wars against the surrounding great powers. The driving force behind these victories is the second prince, Allen, who has mastered magic and possesses overwhelming combat skills. The man who has come to be called a "hero" is actually—"I want to get out of this country! I want to have fun with girls!" This is the story of the strongest prince who wants to live a dissolute life and leaves his mark on history.

(Source: Overlap, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes eight bonus chapters.
synonyms: Heroic Prince of a Weak Nation

title.romaji: Jakushou Kokka no Eiyuu Ouji: Saikyou no Majutsushi dakedo Sassato kuni dete Jiyuu ni Ikiteee!

210035.description:
Her family always put her brother first. Her fiancé always put his best friend first. However, after Sylvia has been looked down on just for expressing her desires her entire life and too many betrayals from her fiancé to count, she decides enough is enough. She declares that she's done being everyone's afterthought and is going to prioritize herself from now on. That very day, a split-second judgment to rescue a young street urchin turns out to be a decision that will change her life. She quickly realizes that the young boy is actually the emperor's illegitimate child Leon, and her own talents are soon discovered by the emperor's half-brother, the "Battle-Crazed Duke", Wilhart. Wilhart asks Sylvia to be Leon's attendant in the Imperial Palace, and for the first time in her life, she feels needed. And despite the rumors of Wilhart's cold, war-hardened demeanor, Sylvia finds him gazing at her with a passion he's never shown anyone else...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

210040.description:
The plan was simple: play the foil, get dumped, live happily ever after. Now? The duke is head over heels for me, the world’s on the brink of war—and I’m going to die.

I was reincarnated into the pages of my favorite romance novel. Not as the bright, beloved heroine, but as the cruel, grasping villainess, a mere stepping stone in the story. My only job is to dump the “Cold-Hearted Duke” so he can meet his true love. Fail, and war breaks out. I die. Nobody gets their happily ever after.

Easy, right?

Except playing a vindictive noblewoman when I’d been an ordinary woman in my past life is harder than it looks. Because if that’s the case, why—at the end of it all—is the duke holding me close, murmuring into my ear, “Grace… I will never, ever let you go”?!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

210041.description:
The Demon King who brought darkness to the world has been defeated by the hero, and the light has returned. But the Demon King leaves a part of himself behind as a successor known as Valaris III. To regain their reign of darkness, the new Demon King ventures out of the demon castle and heads to our world, but where they emerge is... From the creator of Gintama comes a devilish new comedy!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

2. Chouhi wa Ori ni Torawarenai: Koutei Heika no Tame ni Dansou Kanri to shite Hatarakimasu! (寵妃は檻に囚われない～皇帝陛下のために男装官吏として働きます！～) [Anbata x Ichiha Hiiragi]

4. Koukyuu Meihi wa Hiya Mukuro Heika wo Shina Setakunai (後宮冥妃は冷骸陛下を死なせたくない) [Iroha Sakimiya x Touko Amekawa]

210043.description:
Kim Ji-Su is a hotel housekeeper who can uncover guests’ secrets by reading the “stains of memory” left behind in their rooms. Using this ability, she runs a side business spying on guests’ private lives and blackmailing them. One day, while cleaning the room of a guest named Yeon-U, who had particularly caught her eye, she comes face to face with a memory she should never have seen.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 하우스키핑

210044.description:
Seung-Ho Gwon was once a terrifying underworld legend, but now he’s just an unassuming salaryman trying to survive the corporate grind. His peaceful life is shattered, however, when he reverts to his violent instincts and beats up a vital business partner-- a blunder that leaves his company with catastrophic losses and a warehouse of unmovable stock. To save his career, Seung-Ho must navigate cutthroat office politics and the criminal streets he once ruled to move the inventory. Can Seung-Ho settle the debt as a regular employee, or will “The Legend” have to come out of retirement to finish the job?

(Source: WEBTOON)

210047.description:
Yun Si-Ho has one goal: to survive university without becoming one half of the school’s first official gay couple. But his best friend and classmate, Ji Seung-Hyeon, is making that impossible with his relentless, daily advances. Just as Si-Ho hits his breaking point, a mysterious app appears on his phone, claiming to show the "affection levels" of handsome men. Si-Ho sees his chance. He’ll use the app to systematically lower Seung-Hyeon’s feelings and finally get his peace! There’s just one problem: no matter what Si-Ho does, Seung-Hyeon’s meter keeps rising... and it’s not just his affection that’s standing tall.

(Source: Lezhin US)

210069.description:
An unsuccessful mangaka, RObou-sensei, finally has his series axed... Dejected, he opens social media and discovers an account that is absolutely obsessed with his work! When he learns they plan to sell doujinshi based on his series at a convention, he heads there, hoping to meet at least one person who genuinely likes what he draws, but then...?! That hugely popular one-shot that trended on social media is now becoming a full serialization! A miscommunication comedy that explores otaku culture and depicts the realities of being a mangaka with a comedic touch! A story where the creator "god" and an otaku "believer" keep talking past each other.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

210074.description:
Roberta, a priestess of the church, is designated as the head priestess of a remote region in the northern edge—Dithmar. As the appointment came immediately after the disappearance of her predecessor, Roberta remained on guard and began to investigate Duke Ulrich of Dithmarschen. According to rumors, he has ruled over the region's lord for over 300 years, and even claimed to be an immortal... one who lives a life no human should be capable of possessing. Determined to uncover the truth, Roberta decides to trace his steps.

(Source: Naver, translated)

210078.description:
Pyo-Geol, the eldest son of a once-wealthy family now in decline, needs an heir to restore his family’s fortunes, but for some reason, his wife has been unable to conceive for several years. Pyo-Geol considers adopting a child for his wife’s sake, but his father insists that the child must be of Pyo-Geol’s own blood. Unable to bear it any longer, his father proposes a secret strategy passed down through the family for generations, which involves conceiving a child by engaging in a relationship with a monster hidden within the family.

Will Pyo-Geol ultimately follow his father’s will?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.native: 허릉몽

210079.description:
Kang Seong-Ho’s wedding ring, which had fallen into his hands by chance. It would have been over if he had simply returned it. But on a sudden impulse, Choi Yun-Jae hides the ring’s whereabouts and finds himself confronting a darkness he must never let his older brother see. Is it loyalty, or obsession? Or perhaps a desire he cannot even admit to himself?

What exactly awaits at the end of this dangerous relationship?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.native: 월간 느와르: 반지

210080.description:

210387.description:
Shirei is one of his Shirato Sanpei's earliest works, published the year after his 1957 debut Kogarashi Kenshi. It is notable for remaining unreprinted to this day, even as many of his earlier works have been reprinted or reissued. While the title on the cover is Shirei, the title on the frontispiece is Noroi no Kage.

Set in Showa-era Japan shortly after the end of the Pacific War, the story depicts a father and son tormented by the vengeful spirits of the dead that repeatedly attack them, and their struggle to confront these forces. The exact reason why it has not been reprinted or reissued for so long since its initial publication is unclear, but it is thought that the vivid depictions of the military oppressing innocent civilians in the South Pacific during the war—inserted as the protagonist’s father’s flashbacks in the first half of the story—and the gravity of the content may be factors contributing to the delay in its reissue.

Ryo, my husband of six months, has become distant lately. Every time I speak to him, he seems irritated and responds with sharp words. Our strained relationship has taken a significant mental toll on me, but thankfully, I can lean on my best friend Miku. She's someone truly precious whom I trust and can confide in about anything. One day, I decide to surprise Miku with a visit, only to find my husband's car parked outside her apartment. He'd told me he was heading out for golf with his boss early that morning, but it turns out he was lying. The truth? He's been sleeping with my best friend behind my back! And as if that weren't enough, he showers her with affection he never shows me while also trash-talking me. Are the sharp wits and quick reflexes of wunderkind detectives Narutaki and pretty nurse Ling Ling enough to thwart evil and unravel the mysteries of this strange world? All steamed up.... When Narutaki meets Ling Ling, a pretty nurse with a dark secret, he gains both a true-blu friend and two new assistants. After that strange reunion in 10 years, Akari's ordinary life starts to crumble...! Outbursts of love, twisted desires, unpleasant memories... Husband, wife, and her ex-boyfriend. Who's the craziest? Is marriage even on the table?!

The employee who showed up was Ritsu Kogami, their first ever male employee. She thought he was a good and diligent guy, even though he was somewhat strange. One day, she was suddenly hugged by him from behind...! He said, "You're way too cute." What on earth was he thinking...? The next day, Ritsu's behavior escalated even further...

The kind and compassionate sister Belle and the intelligent and book-savvy brother Stephan have been living an increasingly modest lifestyle so that their people can continue to survive the seasons... though they are unsure how many more winters they can manage. Suddenly, a proposition comes to them from the servant of a well ornamented Marquis. The son of this Marquis, Evert Brotaire and his fiancée Elena Gromberg are displeased with their engagement and wish to find someone to marry out of love. It seems that this Marquis wishes for the twins to give the couple experiences of love, only to break their hearts and disappear so that the two will finally cling to one another and marry. The twins are hesitant to take such an underhanded job, but things change when they get the chance to meet this troubled couple...!

In that world, the Falconers and their society were part of a video game—one Albert remembers just well enough to know that he was a far cry from a main character! Albert begins his studies at the Radford Royal Academy of Magic with that past life in the back of his mind. 210986.description:
Hae-Jin and Ki-Hyeok met at the same taekwondo dojo when they were children. They used to be quite close, but as their respective paths in life took shape, their relationship became distant and awkward, almost as if they were strangers. In fact, ever since their days at the taekwondo dojo, Hae-Jin has always looked up to Ki-Hyeok, and finally, at the start of their freshman year of high school, the two reunite in the same school and the same class. However, Ki-Hyuk appears in such a disheveled state that he shatters Hae-Jin’s expectations. Despite this, Hae-Jin’s feelings for Ki-Hyeok refused to fade; instead, his obsession and determination kicked in, and he resolved to restore the object of her admiration to his former glory with her own hands. And so, Hae-Jin’s inexplicable obsession with Ki-Hyeok— his grand transformation project—began.

A cram school dormitory in the height of summer. Before Gwang-Tae, who has turned his back on the world and is just getting by, appears Bo-Ae, a girl who longs to exist in this world. Lady Jacqueline Summerset loses everything after her father’s disappearance and her family’s bankruptcy. Accepting the need to begin anew, she becomes the thirteenth private tutor at the Preston estate. There, she clashes with the infamous Marquess of Preston, not just in temperament but in principle. Jacqueline believes a child should be taught with care, warmth, and love, while the Marquess insists strict discipline is the only way to shape a proper heir. As their opposing methods collide day after day, Jacqueline begins to glimpse the secrets the Marquess keeps hidden, and finds herself growing unexpectedly closer to the man who seems her complete opposite.

(Source: WEBTOON)

210990.description:
Blair Ardel was forced into a political marriage with the cold Duke Herdin Delmarque. Though she loved her husband and treasured their son, her marriage ended in betrayal when she was murdered one night. But instead of dying, Blair awakens three years in the past. Determined to reunite with her son and uncover the truth behind her murder, she agrees to marry Herdin once more, this time through a contract marriage on her own terms. As secrets, conspiracies, and feelings begin to resurface, Blair must decide whether fate can be changed… or if she is doomed to lose everything again.

(Source: WEBTOON)

210991.description:
Rie Sasayama is 24 years old and 5 foot 6 inches tall. Often asked if she's angry. It's probably just her face, or the fact that she's generally expressionless. Used to being called strong. Chose her current job because it was close to her apartment. There's no other reason. Rie does not want to be considered bad at her job, so she works hard. When one task is finished, the next is waiting -- it's an endless cycle of having to give it her all, all the time. In the midst of all that, a young guy approaches her one day and asks if she's hungry, not an ounce of ill intent in his expression. Rie's not particularly lovable, neither in appearance nor personality, so what is this guy talking to her for...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

210992.description:
After her mother’s death, Louise is left destitute with her only inheritance being a mysterious pearl. Unaware of its immense value as an imperial heirloom, Louise attempts to pawn it to fund her mother’s burial. However, Crown Prince Cauis, disguised as the Margrave of Burg ever since he was betrayed by Louise’s mother, manipulates Louise to have her pay for her dead mother’s sins. Trapped in a conspiracy of seduction, politics, and revenge, Louise must decide if she can trust Caius with both her heart and the Pearl of Albrecht.

(Source: Tappytoon)

At 32, Yurika is devastated after discovering that her nearly five-year relationship was, in fact, an affair. Forced to transfer, her new coworker drags her to a welcome party where she catches the eye of a college student sitting across them. Feeling distraught, the calm and cool, Aoi, whisks her away. Despite being ten years younger than her, she gives in to a night of passion with him. Several months later, who walks in but the very man she thought she'd never meet again, Aoi. Will their relationship blossom or will it remain purely friends with benefits?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Chihiro Suzuki, a serious and reserved college boy, meets Miyu Washio, an older girl with an incredibly positive attitude, while working at a convenience store near his new home.

“Let’s make some happy memories right now!”

Her unpredictable ideas for “fun” — and her wholehearted enjoyment of the moment — gradually transforms his dull and uneventful daily life. From their slightly offbeat conversations, an unexpected new chapter in their lives begins.

This is a sweet and fresh coming-of-age romantic comedy that starts with “friendship”!

She couldn’t hope for more, no matter how strong her feelings for him. But leaving Luca behind will prove difficult—he’s carved his passion into Emily’s body and she can’t get him out of her mind…
